newsitem.title: TUNISIA: BNA bank reports higher '96 profits.
newsitem.headline: BNA bank reports higher '96 profits.

text.p: Tunisia's Banque Nationale Agricole on Tuesday said its net profits for 1996 amounted to 19.43 million dinars, up from 14.69 million dinars in 1995.
The state-controlled bank said it started distributing a 1.0 dinar dividend per share for 1996 results, unchanged from its level for 1995.

It said it had allocated 40.73 million dinars to reserves and write-offs, lower than the amount of 130.67 million dinars accountants said was needed as reserves for 1996 in regard to the bank's liabilities.
The bank's capital at end of 1996 was 100 million dinars and reserves were 67.25 million dinars.
BNA early in 1997 recovered 980 million dinars worth of bad debt owed to it by cereals and olive oil state bodies.
